STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast/snack tray: a muffin, a slice of bread, a cup of tea (with milk), a yogurt cup, and two creamer/milk portions. Not a single-plate meal; the items sit on two small paper plates.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Two side plates (~20 cm diameter each, area ~314 cm² each). The muffin sits on one; the bread slice on the other. The tea and yogurt are separate containers.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Muffin (savoury, with bits of green and nuts/seeds)
- Bread slice (white/sourdough-style, one thick slice)
- Yogurt cup (~150 g container, likely fruit yogurt)
- Tea with milk (in a white mug, ~250 ml)
- Two creamer/milk portions (~10 ml each)

STEP 4 - Area (of each plate, 314 cm²):
- Muffin: ~35% of its plate, ~110 cm². Height ~5 cm (domed), volume ~550 ml envelope, but muffin is airy: use density ~0.4 → ~220 g... (see below, rescaled to a realistic muffin of ~60 g).
- Bread slice: ~45% of its plate, ~140 cm², height ~2 cm → 280 ml × 0.3 (bread slice density, airy crumb) ≈ 84 g. Cross-check: a standard thick slice is ~30–40 g, so I take ~40 g.

STEP 5–6 - Grams:
- Muffin: ~60 g (small muffin; visible volume ~110 cm² × 4 cm × 0.15 ≈ 66 g after reducing to a realistic muffin mass).
- Bread slice: ~40 g.
- Yogurt: ~150 g (single cup).
- Tea with milk: ~200 g (mostly liquid, milky tea ~0.2 kg with small milk content).
- Creamers: 2 × 10 g = 20 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Muffin: ~380 kcal/100 g → 60 g = 228 kcal
- Bread: ~265 kcal/100 g → 40 g = 106 kcal
- Yogurt (fruit, low-fat): ~100 kcal/100 g → 150 g = 150 kcal
- Milky tea (with milk, little sugar): ~30 kcal/100 g → 200 g = 60 kcal
- Creamers (cream/milk, ~20% fat): ~200 kcal/100 g → 20 g = 40 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 530 g and ≈ 584 kcal. For a breakfast tray with a muffin, a slice of bread, a yogurt, and tea, this is plausible. Most estimates are rough, given the visible items are small.
